name: no interference (plate, motor, extrusion, 6 screws; M3 thread engagement excluded)
motor body clears the extrusion by >= 1 mm
motor body lies inside the plate in x and y
M3 engagement into the motor, worst case, stays below the 0.15 in (3.81) minimum thread depth
screw heads never stand proud of the top face (counterbore depth min >= head height k max)
M5 screw tip, worst case, stays inside the extrusion slot (6 deep, assumed)
material under every screw head: shear capacity >= 3 x preload and floor >= 0.8 d
